payload.title: Repair Frank bug-feedback and Harness integrity regressions
payload.work_clay: Reproduce and repair FB-01..FB-13 from research_entity/research/frank/FRANK_BUGSEARCH_20260809T1941p0700.md plus its ADDENDUM against current Frank remote main. Highest priority is one canonical V13/bug trigger schema contract, one authoritative exact-bug dispatcher excluded from generic skill invocation, immutable or explicitly revisioned bug identity, atomic Frank DB/export publication, explicit same-ID/different-hash conflict handling in Clay ingest, executed CI regressions, and fail-closed Harness canonical state opening. Preserve concurrent Harness/loop-dynamics work and re-read remote main before every Frank mutation. Then harden pair-persistence diagnostics, session identity, secret scrubbing and watcher quarantine/checkpoint behavior.
payload.reason_clay: The audit found source-level contradictions across Frank schema truth gates, exact-command routing, bug payload identity, cross-repo deduplication, file-vs-DB publication order, reserved trigger migration, CI coverage and legacy Harness state opening. These defects can make a bug report disappear, double-route as a generic skill, diverge silently between Frank and Clay, leak an orphan export, fail migration, or recreate stale partial central state even though older deep-integrity receipts passed.
payload.completion_clay: All FB-01..FB-13 have reproducible test dispositions. Current schema manifest/truth/materializer gates fail closed without the exact bug channel contract; exact bug has one authoritative dispatch path and creates no generic skill invocation; v12→v13 migration handles preexisting bug-trigger collision explicitly; repeated identical captures are byte/hash-idempotent or use immutable revision identity; DB failure cannot expose an uncommitted consumable export; Clay same-ID/different-hash is an explicit conflict; bug-feedback pytest regressions and Harness Python/state-boundary checks execute in CI; every normal Harness entrypoint fails closed on missing canonical DBs; pair persistence failures are observable; full/collision-resistant session identity is consistent; shared secret scrubber passes supported credential corpus; watcher checkpoints or quarantines invalid content revisions; restart/recovery and Ubuntu target-host end-to-end bug capture→Clay ingest receipts pass; no known P0/P1 remains in this lane.
payload.executor_policy: Research-Entity-owned repair only. Frank may report/observe but does not mutate its own Harness. Prefer a worker with current Frank checkout plus local test execution; preserve all concurrent remote-main changes, use small reviewable commits, add failing regression before or with each fix, and do not claim Andreas-PC deployment until a target-host receipt exists.
